---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the pain point, not the solution.

*Example: "I want to see which journal entries correlate with my best sleep, but there's no way to cross-reference sleep data with mood data."*

## Proposed Solution

What would you like to see happen? Be specific.

## Who This Helps

- Solo users?
- Self-hosters?
- Developers building on MyMindMirror?
- All of the above?

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is your proposed solution better?

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other projects, or references to relevant sections of the README.

## Scope Check

- [ ] This feature doesn't require a paid third-party service (beyond the existing Gemini integration)
- [ ] This feature doesn't weaken the encryption-at-rest guarantee
- [ ] This feature doesn't break the existing REST API contract
- [ ] I've checked the [Roadmap / Known Limitations](https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/mymindmirror#roadmap--known-limitations) section — this isn't already planned or deferred

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate
- [ ] This is a feature request, not a bug (bugs should use the Bug Report template)
- [ ] I'm willing to help implement this if the approach is agreed upon
